items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: In fact Billy Strayhorn — he didn’t dance, he wrote — but he was part of that club, the Copasetics.

ctx.x: They were older gentlemen who danced, tap danced. And they were like mentors to, if you mentioned the Copasetics. In fact Billy Strayhorn — he didn’t dance, he wrote — but he was part of that club, the Copasetics. But the Copasetics were a group of dancers. There is a movie out, it’s an older movie, and they all have a part in it. I think Sammy Davis is in the movie, I can’t think of the name. I saw it again recently on TV. I’ll do some research and write you and let you know.
Were you a member of the union?
